title: Level 4 (Expert) - D-8
notes:
West leads the ♠K against 5♣. West wins the first 2 spade tricks as East follows and West's diamond shift is taken by dummy's ♦A (finessing would be an unnecessary risk). South will be able to ruff his heart loser in dummy, but must avoid losing a trump trick in the process.

If East has all 4 clubs then South will be able to succeed with a trump coup, provided that he takes the precaution of ruffing a diamond in his hand at once. South crosses to the dummy in clubs and West's discard reveals the 4-0 trump break. South ruffs another diamond in hand and cashes 2 high hearts.

In the above layout South can afford to cash his third heart winner. There are several winning sequences from this point. South can, for example, ruff the ♥2 in dummy and cash dummy's remaining trump. With the lead in dummy at trick 12, East's remaining ♣10 doubleton is picked up through a trump coup.

It would, in fact, be an unnecessary risk for South to cash the third round of hearts. If East was dealt a doubleton heart, he could ruff to defeat the contract. South can guarantee the contract from this point by ruffing both of his remaining hearts in the dummy. South gets back to his hand with a ruff in order to ruff his last heart in the dummy as East is forced to underruff. The lead is in the dummy and East's remaining ♣10 doubleton is caught in a trump coup as before.
